name: Nono to Kuraso!
source:
Are you happy with just looking?
Nekomiya Nono starts to cohabitate with protagonist. She does the chores like cleaning or cooking and gives shy treats like cute gestures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
你只满足于看着她吗？
猫宫乃乃开始与主人公共同生活。她会打扫、做饭等家务，也会用可爱的小动作羞涩地带给他惊喜。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-august-2007-ninkyou-hana.html]vndbreview[/url]]
